$comment: The server images for R, MATLAB cells (GNU Octave) and Julia, shared by src/lib/server/modal.ts and scripts/modal-image.mjs (prebuilds them). R and Octave are Ubuntu 24.04's own packages: the exact set the run commands were tested with (2026-11-18), including what Octave needs to write PNGs (gnuplot, Ghostscript, the FreeSans font). python3 is for bj_capture.py --collect, which gathers the figures a run wrote.

commands: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 r-base-core r-base-dev r-cran-tidyverse r-cran-ggplot2 r-cran-dplyr r-cran-tidyr r-cran-readr r-cran-data.table r-cran-mass r-cran-lme4 r-cran-survival r-cran-randomforest r-cran-caret r-cran-glmnet r-cran-e1071 r-cran-forecast && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 octave octave-statistics octave-signal octave-optim octave-control gnuplot-nox ghostscript fontconfig fonts-dejavu-core fonts-freefont-otf && fc-cache -f && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
